title: Erdős Problem 142 (Asymptotic Density of k-AP-Free Sets)
statement_plain: Find an asymptotic formula for r_k(N), the maximum size of a subset of {1, ..., N} containing no non-trivial k-term arithmetic progression; in particular, determine whether r_k(N) = o(N / (log N)^C) for all C > 0 and pin down the true growth rate between Behrend-type lower bounds and Kelley–Meka / Leng–Sah–Sawhney upper bounds.
